shots.name: proposed-buttons
shots.expect: js:document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]')?.dataset.planStatus === 'proposed' && [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=plan-block] button')].some(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Approve') && !!document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-ceiling]') && [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=plan-ceiling] button')].map(b=>b.textContent.trim()).join('|') === 'Comment|Approve' && (()=>{const r=document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-ceiling] span').getBoundingClientRect(), a=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=plan-ceiling] button')].pop().getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.abs((r.top+r.bottom)/2-(a.top+a.bottom)/2) < 8 && a.left > r.left})()

shots.name: chip-popup-plan-collapsed
shots.expect: js:!!document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-group-toggle] button') && document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-group-toggle] button').getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'false' && !!document.querySelector('[data-testid=helper-card-child-2]') && ![...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].some(h => h.textContent.trim().toLowerCase() === 'plans') && document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-group-plan-1]').getBoundingClientRect().width === document.querySelector('[data-testid=helper-card-child-2]').getBoundingClientRect().width && document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-group-toggle]').textContent.includes('Plan: Review the auth module')

shots.name: handoff-pending-chat
shots.expect: js:document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]')?.dataset.handoff === 'pending' && !!document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-handoff-pending]') && document.body.textContent.includes('Let me check how much is left') && !document.querySelector('[data-testid=specialist-report-card]') && !document.body.textContent.includes('Note for the assistant')
